title: Four-mode front door with request routing
description:
Adds the entry-point logic that classifies an opening request into one of jit-project-lead's four invocation modes and routes it to the right path, with mode 1 (lead existing strategic work) fully functional end to end.

## Background

jit-project-lead supports four entry paths: (1) lead an already-existing strategic container, (2) plan-and-execute a vague high-level goal from a cold start, (3) hold a steering discussion (interactive vision/decision work, no workers dispatched), and (4) run a project-wide content-standards sweep. Modes 2 and 3 hand off to `jit-planning-lead` invoked at the strategic altitude (its interview step and its recursion step); mode 4 hands off to the standards-sweep mode.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Given a representative opening request for each of the four modes, the skill routes to the correct mode.
- [hard] REQ-02: Mode 1 (lead existing strategic work) resolves an existing strategic-tier container from the opening request and hands it to the sub-strategic dispatch protocol with the resolved container and invocation context supplied. Wave execution, coherence review, and charter/progress maintenance are outside the front door's scope.
- [hard] REQ-03: Modes 2 and 3 route to `jit-planning-lead` invoked at the strategic altitude; mode 4 routes to the standards-sweep mode.
